from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
from uuid import uuid4

class FormParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_form = False
        self.fields = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'form' and attrs.get('class') == 'add-form':
            self.in_form = True
        elif tag == 'input' and self.in_form and attrs.get('type') == 'hidden':
            self.fields.append((attrs['name'], attrs.get('value', '')))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'form':
            self.in_form = False

url = 'http://localhost:3100/'
parser = FormParser()
parser.feed(urlopen(url).read().decode())
fields = parser.fields + [('title', 'The Left Hand of Darkness'), ('author', 'Ursula K. Le Guin'), ('notes', 'A note to remember.\\nSecond line.')]
boundary = '----margin-' + uuid4().hex
body = b''
for name, value in fields:
    body += ('--' + boundary + '\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"' + name + '\"\\r\\n\\r\\n' + value + '\\r\\n').encode()
body += ('--' + boundary + '--\\r\\n').encode()
req = Request(url, body, headers={'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary}, method='POST')
response = urlopen(req)
html = response.read().decode()
print('POST final URL:', response.url)
print('Title on home:', 'The Left Hand of Darkness' in html)
print('Author on home:', 'Ursula K. Le Guin' in html)
PY"

class FormParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.current = None
        self.forms = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'form':
            self.current = []
        elif tag == 'input' and self.current is not None:
            self.current.append((attrs.get('name', ''), attrs.get('value', '')))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'form' and self.current is not None:
            self.forms.append(self.current)
            self.current = None
